description: Selective integration manifest for the pure motion library on main. It describes only what is integrated and lists everything else as DEFERRED. It does not replace or re-validate the sealed integration-branch manifest.
deferred_policy: Deferred rows record path and SHA-256 only, never content. A deferred path MUST be absent from this tree; the gate fails if one appears. Deferral is not validation: no result of the sealed manifest is claimed for these files.
scope: Pinned pure motion library (src/motion) and canonical inputs. No live motion adapter. Execution suites (motion host tests, fresh oracles, audit-tool tests) are DEFERRED with the files they need.
